messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: ImageRename
parts:
Hi, 
It seems that your stations are not found. Can you elaborate on your directory structure please? For example give the output of 

head(list.dirs("D:/TimeShifted"))

Is U211 the name of a station? If so, then the directories are not specified correctly in your function call. inDir and outDir are the directories that contain all the station directories. 
Assuming TimeShifted is a directory containing several station directories and U211 is one of your station directories, you'd need to define the directories as:

wd_raw     <- "D:/TimeShifted"            

wd_renamed <- "D:/TimeshiftRenamed"
